g.text: What equation must the residual satisfy when no parameter direction can lower half-MSE?

g.text: Conclusion: dJ = -e^T X dw / N, so gradient J = -X^T e / N. At a minimum X^T e = 0, equivalently X^T X w = X^T y. Positive

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: semidefinite curvature makes stationarity sufficient, even if rank is deficient.
